It is related to belief, culture, ritual or institutional religion, but it misses the decisive clue here: charities organised around a religious faith are naturally described as faith-based.

Faith-related — is a neutral descriptive label for matters connected with faith, often in policy, research or service contexts. It is related to belief, culture, ritual or institutional religion, but it misses the decisive clue here: charities organised around a religious faith are naturally described as faith-based.
